Second opinions

How it works

Scroll to walk through the four steps.

1Step 1 of 4

Share your story

Tell me what you’ve been told: your diagnosis, the treatment that’s been recommended and the questions on your mind. A short intake form or a call with my team is all it takes.

2Step 2 of 4

Send your imaging

Share your MRI or CT scans and the radiology, pathology and operative reports. A disc or an online sharing link both work — my team will help you track anything down.

3Step 3 of 4

I review your case

I look at the images myself, not just the reports, alongside your history and the proposed plan — weighing minimally invasive, traditional and non-surgical options.

4Step 4 of 4

We talk it through

We meet in person or by video to go over what I see, what I’d recommend and why. You’ll leave with a clear plan and a written summary you can share with your doctors.

  • Minimally invasive approach
  • Traditional approach
  • Non-surgical management
